text:
Zara P.: Heads-up: EdgeForge (HW partner) and NovaIntegrate (SI) both claimed acct_5544 via different flows. EdgeForge claimed because customer needs on-prem HW staging; Nova claimed for integration services and scheduled a joint-announcement. Both flips landed in SF and now forecast + launch PR windows are duplicated.

Caleb M.: Oof. Which window is more urgent?

Zara P.: acct_5544 has a hard announcement embargo (2026-07-14) and a hardware staging slot the week prior. We can't have two outreach tracks.

Nina (NovaIntegrate): We filled the marketplace intake with co_sell_role=SI_lead and announce_window=2026-07-14. We thought that made it joint. We also scheduled a pre-demo integration call.

Theo (EdgeForge): EdgeForge added a hardware_claim token via the hardware partner portal to reserve lab time. The portal assumed reservation = ownership eligibility and flipped owner. Our outreach was paused but the SF change happened automatically.

Priya S.: We need two immediate things: 1) a temporary freeze on any marketplace or hardware-portal-triggered owner flips for accounts with announce_window or embargo fields; 2) a stitching policy that prefers embargo dates and creates a single joint-play record with roles (HW_lead, SI_lead, Redwood_lead).

Caleb M.: Agreed. For launch accounts we require partnerships ack before any owner change. Also add a field announce_embargo_date and a boolean announce_locked.

Nina (NovaIntegrate): Nova will pause any scheduled invites until you confirm the joint plan. We want clear roles: Nova can run the integration demo; EdgeForge will run HW staging and provide kit. Redwood to handle pricing/announce comms? Open to whatever fits.

Theo (EdgeForge): EdgeForge concurs. We'll mark our lab reservation as a "reservation" not owner change and include hardware-kit serials in the intake so ops knows staging needs.

Zara P.: crm-bot: can you add a note and place announce_locked=true on acct_5544 and revert the SF owner change until partnerships confirms?

crm-bot: Automated note added to acct_5544: "Conflicting marketplace/hardware portal claims detected. announce_locked=true. Ownership reverted to previous owner pending partnerships reconciliation." :white_check_mark:

Priya S.: Drafting a quick automation patch. Proposed YAML (staging):
```yaml
trigger: external_claim_with_announce_window
actions:
  - set_field: announce_locked=true
  - add_tag: pending-partnerships-reconcile
  - notify: [partnerships, owner, partner]
  - create_task: reconcile_claims
  - revert_owner_if_conflict: true
  - hold_announcements_until: partnerships_clears
```

Caleb M.: Also add an analytics event claim_conflict to feed forecasting dedupe. Finance wants a percent_split field on any joint assigned opp for commissions.

Nina (NovaIntegrate): We'll update our intake to include announce_window and a checkbox "ok_for_joint_announce"; will stop sends until we get the greenlight.

Theo (EdgeForge): We'll change the hardware portal to emit reservation tokens only and include a serial list + staging dates. No owner flips until partnerships gives the assignment.

Zara P.: Next steps: Priya stage automation (due EOD), partners update forms (Nova & EdgeForge) by tomorrow, partnerships reconcile and publish one-pager with the new embargo+stitch rules (due 48h). We'll reassign acct_5544 after the reconciliation.

Priya S.: Staging rule created. Will roll to prod after the one-pager is posted.

Caleb M.: I'll coordinate the recon call with Nova & EdgeForge and Marketing to lock the announce owner. Meeting invite to follow.

Zara P.: Thanks everyone. Closing when the announce_locked flag is cleared and the joint-play record is created. :lock:
